summary: Boundary County, ID 40-foot pole tower in an old ranger station yard, dated 1928 and abandoned in the 1940s; a statewide list says standing, present condition unknown.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags it Drive-Up. The tower stood in an old station yard, so check with the forest before going to look for it.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The statewide list says standing; Kamstra and Idaho Fire Lookouts say abandoned in the 1940s and do not say whether the pole remains. Recorded as unknown until a recent visit or report is found.

notes_for_editor: Status is unresolved: the statewide index says Tower Standing, while two detailed pages say abandoned in the 1940s and do not confirm the pole remains. The abandonment is dated only to the decade, so no event was entered. No staffing history or fire found. Neither detailed page gives a visit date. The Idaho Panhandle roll-call PDF (ppolinks.com/forestservicemuseum/2022_1_11.pdf) lists Smith Creek district as Copeland in 1927; not cited, worth checking if the station's name history matters.
